spanish: Al lugar aquel llamó torrente de Eshcol, sobre asuntos del racimo que cortaron desde allí hijos de Israel.

findings.issue: עַל־אֹדוֹת is the plural construct of cause/reason ('on account of'); 'sobre asuntos' replaces that cause with affairs/matters.

notes: Other tokens match person, number, and the proper/common split of אשכול; Israel is the locked name.
